explanation: No horned helmet from a Viking Age warrior has been found. The image spread through 19th-century art and the costumes of Wagner's opera cycle The Ring, staged in 1876.

claims.text: There is no evidence that Viking Age warriors (about AD 800 to 1050) wore horned helmets in battle.
No horned helmet belonging to a Viking Age warrior has been found by archaeologists.
Costume designs for the first Bayreuth staging of Wagner's Ring cycle, in 1876, gave Norse characters horned helmets.
19th-century art helped spread the image of horned Viking helmets.
